name: Shadow Warriors

specialRules.name: Hate Dark Elves
specialRules.text: All warriors in the warband (excluding Hired Swords) have an unyielding Hatred for Dark Elves.

specialRules.name: Excellent Sight
specialRules.text: Elves in the warband can spot Hidden enemies from twice as far away as other warriors (twice their Initiative in inches).

specialRules.name: Distaste for Poison
specialRules.text: Warriors in the warband may not use poisons of any type.

specialRules.name: Unforgiving
specialRules.text: In multiplayer games the warband may never ally with a warband of a Chaotic nature (Possessed, Skaven, Beastmen, Dark Elves, etc).

specialRules.name: Tolerant
specialRules.text: May hire any Hired Sword that is not Chaotic or evil (no Skaven, Possessed, Beastmen, Dark Elves, etc) and none specialising in poison (no Assassins).

equipmentLists.name: Shadow Warrior equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Shadow Master, Shadow Walkers, Shadow Weaver, Shadow Warriors, Shadow Warrior Novices

items.name: Ithilmar weapon
items.note: Heroes only. 2 x price of the base weapon.

items.name: Standard of Nagarythe
items.note: Heroes only. Full cost 75 + 3D6 gc / Rare 9. Only at warband creation. Shadow Warriors only. Models within 12" re-roll failed Ld tests; if captured/taken out of action, all warband gains Hatred for the rest of the game and may not voluntarily rout. Carrier needs one hand free; may be used as a spear at -1 to hit.

items.name: War Horn of Nagarythe
items.note: Heroes only. Full cost 25 + 1D6 gc / Rare 6. Once per game at start of own turn, all models +1 Ld (max 10) until start of next turn; may be used before a Rout test.

items.name: Elven Wine
items.note: Heroes only. Full cost 30 + 3D6 gc / Rare 10. One use; warband immune to Fear for the whole battle. Shadow Warriors only.

items.name: Elven Runestones
items.note: Heroes only. Full cost 50 + 2D6 gc / Rare 11. Mage may attempt to dispel a successfully cast spell (roll equal or above caster's score). Shadow Weavers only.

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior within 6" may use his Leadership when taking any Leadership tests.

specialRules.name: Wizard
specialRules.text: Wizard; may use Shadow Warrior Magic. May not cast spells if wearing armour.

fighters.name: Shadow Warrior
fighters.notes: Bought in groups of 1-5 models. Racial maximums are as for all Elves (rulebook p.121).

conversionNotes: PDF has a Special skill table with Infiltration, See in Shadows, Hide in Shadows, Sniper, Powerful Build, Master of Runes; Special is listed in each hero's skills.
Ithilmar weapon is priced at 2 x the base weapon, so listCost is 0 with the rule in note. Heroes only.
Miscellaneous items are printed with a flat list price (heroes-only price in Ulthuan); the dice-based costs and Rarity from the item text are in notes. Items marked * are heroes only.
Special skill Powerful Build: only two members of the warband may ever have it.
No d6 roll wording in fighter or warband special rules; the spell list is D6-based (d6 spell table and difficulties left to the app).
